name: Karchive
subtitle: Somesh Kar's experiments, as apps you can install
description: Apps from Somesh Kar's experiments: systems, voice, agents and whatever else needed an iPhone or iPad to try out. Built on his own machines, unsigned; SideStore or LiveContainer signs them on your device. Expect rough edges, and new builds often.

apps.name: Scan3D
apps.subtitle: LiDAR scan with real millimetre scale
apps.localizedDescription: Guided LiDAR capture. Press START, walk around the object, press EXPORT. Frames are auto-sampled only when the light is good, the motion is slow and the direction is new; the LiDAR measures the object in millimetres so no calipers are needed. Exports photos/, poses.json, cloud.ply and calipers.json (source: lidar).

versions.localizedDescription: First build: guided coverage, live lighting checks, LiDAR scale.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan3D uses the camera and LiDAR to measure the object and build a 3D model with real-world millimetre scale.

versions.localizedDescription: iPad layout: sidebar of agents and a grid of pinned agents

apps.name: Vispr
apps.subtitle: Watch and talk to your agents
apps.localizedDescription: Connects to your computer by SSH, over Tailscale or your home network, to watch your Herdr agents, read their terminals and hold Talk to speak to them. On iPad, agents sit in a sidebar and can be pinned to a grid.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vispr listens while you hold Talk, to type what you say into your agent.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: When your computer's speech server isn't reachable, Vispr can turn speech into text on this device.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Vispr connects to your computer over your home network by SSH.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Vispr can ask for Face ID before it uses your SSH key.
